verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm an official Muse app on Mac, so the desktop-app part of the story is delivered. Nothing in the evidence describes OS-level keyboard shortcuts or any ability to see or read what is on the user's screen, which are the power-user parts of the story. Missing for 10: OS-level/global shortcuts, screen-content access or screen awareness, any detail on desktop app features, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Mac app.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: Chat with your agent in the same way you message with other people, using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp.
